title: Grateful Dead Live at Denver Coliseum on 1973-11-21
source: MSR > DAT > CD > Samsung SW-232B extraction (EAC v0.95 prebeta 4) > CDWave v1.71 (tracking) > sector boundary verification (shntool v1.01) > .shn encoding (mkwACT v0.97 beta 1) Patches: MAC (Taped Taped by Glen Finley, Sony 1-point stereo mic > Sony TC-12

ai_review.summary: Soundboard capture of a stellar late‑'73 show with a blazing Playing in the Band sequence and Truckin’ > Nobody’s Fault highlight, though the tape has hiss and occasional patching.
ai_review.review: The performance is widely praised – the second‑set flow with Half‑Step, Playing in the Band, El Paso, Wharf Rat and the Truckin’ → Nobody’s Fault transition is described as “amazing” and a contender for one of the band’s greatest shows. The soundboard source is generally good but suffers from noticeable hiss and a few nasty tape patches that momentarily mar an otherwise strong recording.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers give 5‑star ratings for the music, citing standout songs and setlist flow; recording issues are mentioned but are limited to hiss and occasional patches, keeping overall enjoyment high.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear with decent balance, but noticeable tape hiss and a few nasty patchy sections (especially during the mid‑set jam).

show_quality.setlist_flow: Moving Playing in the Band out of the first‑set closer spot opens up new possibilities; the second set is praised for its energy and seamless transitions, while the encore placement of Uncle John’s Band feels anticlimactic to some.
